---
name: Documentation accuracy report
about: Flag a place where documentation, the README, or the whitepaper claims something that isn't actually true of the code
title: "[ACCURACY] "
labels: accuracy, priority-high
---

This is, deliberately, its own issue template. Per the project's honesty commitment (see the [README](../../README.md)), a report that documentation overstates what the code actually does is treated as high priority — at least as important as a functional bug.

**Where is the inaccurate claim?**
File and section/line.

**What does it currently claim?**
Quote or closely paraphrase it.

**What is actually true?**
What you found when you checked (a failed build, a missing test, an unimplemented function, etc. — please include how you verified this).

**Suggested correction**
